value: `git diff --check` -- named in two AGENTS.md verification gates as a thing that must 'pass' -- cannot see what a lane is about to commit, and does not exit 1. Four states measured at 1cb9909d6 in this repository (exit codes; 0 = clean): a TRACKED file with an unstaged whitespace defect gives `git diff --check` 2, `git diff --cached --check` 0, `git diff --check HEAD` 2. The SAME defect STAGED gives 0 / 2 / 2 -- bare `--check` goes clean the moment `git add` runs, which every lane does before committing, so by the time the gate is usually run it has nothing left to see. A brand-new UNTRACKED file whose every line ends in trailing whitespace gives 0 / 0 / 0: invisible to all three. Staged, that same new file gives 0 / 2 / 2, so `git diff --cached --check` is the ONLY form that ever sees a new file at all -- and a new file is what a tool lane adds most (this lane added seven). The exit code is 2, never 1, so a script testing `-eq 1` reads every defect as clean. THE SOUND GATE is `git diff --check HEAD` (tracked, staged or not) AND `git diff --cached --check` once anything is staged, both exiting 0; state it as those commands, never as 'git diff --check passes'. Recorded in AGENTS.md as first-five-minutes trap 6d, with the table, and both verification-gate paragraphs were corrected to name the two commands.
